name: Villa Las Brisas 29 | New Luxury 4-Bedroom Home for Sale in Hacienda Pinilla, Costa Rica
description:
Welcome to Brisas 29, a stunning single-story luxury residence located within the prestigious gated community of Hacienda Pinilla on Costa Rica’s highly sought-after Guanacaste coast. Combining modern sophistication with tropical elegance, this exceptional property offers resort-style living just minutes from the pristine beaches of the Pacific Ocean.

Set on a generous 2,077 m² lot surrounded by lush tropical landscaping, the home features 711.10 m² (7,654 sq. ft.) of thoughtfully designed living space that seamlessly blends comfort, style, and functionality. Designed with contemporary Costa Rican architecture, the residence showcases clean lines, natural stone accents, soaring ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light and connect indoor and outdoor living spaces effortlessly.

 

The spacious open-concept layout creates an inviting atmosphere ideal for entertaining or everyday living. At the center of the home is a gourmet chef’s kitchen featuring premium finishes, high-end appliances, and elegant design details that complement the home’s refined aesthetic.

The residence includes four spacious bedrooms, each offering a private en suite bathroom for comfort and privacy. The luxurious primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with beautiful views of the tropical surroundings. An additional powder room and dedicated service quarters add convenience and functionality to the home.

 

Outdoor living is equally impressive, with expansive entertainment areas, a private pool, and beautifully landscaped gardens creating your own personal oasis under the Guanacaste sun. Whether hosting guests or relaxing in complete privacy, the outdoor spaces are designed to embrace Costa Rica’s year-round tropical lifestyle.

Additional features include a two-car garage, premium finishes throughout, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions that enhance the home’s modern resort ambiance.

 

As a resident of Hacienda Pinilla, owners enjoy access to more than 4,500 acres of pristine coastal property and world-class amenities, including a championship 18-hole golf course designed by Mike Young, a private beach club with access to three stunning Pacific beaches, scenic hiking and biking trails, horseback riding, tennis courts, an equestrian center, fitness facilities, restaurants, shops, and 24/7 gated security. Residents are also conveniently located near the JW Marriott Resort & Spa.

Ideally situated near Tamarindo, Brisas 29 offers easy access to surfing, sport fishing, sunset sailing, fine dining, wellness retreats, international schools, and Liberia International Airport, located approximately one hour away.

Whether you are searching for a luxury vacation home, full-time residence, or high-performing investment property, Brisas 29 represents an exceptional opportunity to own within one of Costa Rica’s premier luxury beach communities.

For buyers looking for a modern home with true ocean views in Marbella, combined with proximity to world-class surf, Casa Hijau represents a strong opportunity. name: Casa Flores del Mar
description: Perched high on a verdant hillside in the coveted enclave of Las Ventanas, Casa Flores del Mar is a striking 2026 contemporary residence where clean architectural lines, walls of glass, and sweeping ocean views come together in effortless harmony. Set on a generous 1,317 m² lot and offering 2,833 square feet of refined living space across two levels, this four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home is a study in modern tropical luxury — elevated, light-filled, and framed by lush jungle canopy on every side. Here, a sleek infinity-edge pool appears to spill toward the horizon, its glass-paneled deck offering unobstructed views over the treetops and out to sea. Teak loungers invite slow afternoons in the sun, while a tile-topped pergola shelters a shaded dining and lounge area — the ideal setting to gather as the sky melts into the warm pinks and golds of a Playa Grande sunset. Inside, the open-concept living spaces are bathed in natural light and finished with a sophisticated, neutral palette. A dramatic travertine feature wall anchors the main living area, complete with a floating media display and a softly illuminated recessed niche that adds warmth and architectural interest. Large-format porcelain flooring flows seamlessly throughout, reinforcing the home's serene, gallery-like ambiance and its effortless connection to the surrounding landscape. At the heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful. Light oak-toned cabinetry pairs with a stunning marble-veined island and waterfall edge, integrated induction cooktop, dual wall ovens, and premium stainless steel appliances. A marble-clad backsplash and ample bar seating complete a space made for both everyday ease and elegant entertaining, all while framed by views of the tropical hillside beyond. With four well-appointed bedrooms, four full baths, and a convenient powder room, Casa Flores del Mar delivers comfort and privacy in equal measure. A low monthly HOA of $412 ensures the surrounding community and amenities are maintained to the highest standard, offering true turnkey ease in one of Playa Grande's most desirable hillside settings. Modern, move-in ready, and impeccably designed, Casa Flores del Mar is a rare opportunity to own a brand-new architectural residence where every detail celebrates light, nature, and the unmistakable rhythm of life by the sea.
